audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows contradict the page's own prose. Levels 2 through first item are all marked 'Skill' while the whys say her squishy frame 'folds', that she 'cannot answer or escape' the chain, and that you 'still delete her'. Level 6 is marked Neeko even though whys[4] and spikes[1] both call Depth Charge a guaranteed kill there.
audit.why: The packet chart reads Skill / Nautilus x5 / Neeko, which is exactly what the prose describes: even level 1, Nautilus owns 2 through first item, Neeko takes over once she has Ludens/Liandry's.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 to Nautilus and row 6 to Neeko, in both layers as one atomic group, with ratings moved to match.

audit.why: Spikes read levels 2-3 (full chain), level 6 Depth Charge, first item, and her late Ludens/Liandry's flip. That matches both kits and the corrected chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says Depth Charge 'homes through her clone disguise', which is close but misses the actual rule, and Tangle-Barbs is described with no range, no cooldown, and no mention of the fact that it grows after passing through a target.
audit.why: Inherent Glamour breaks on any immobilizing crowd control, so Staggering Blow's root and the Dredge Line pull strip the disguise outright — you do not need to guess which Neeko is real once you have connected. Tangle-Barbs is 1000 range on a 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s cooldown and becomes larger, faster and longer-rooting after it passes through a champion or kills a unit, so the wave in front of you makes it worse, not safer.
audit.corrected: Any immobilize breaks Inherent Glamour — your root reveals her. Tangle-Barbs is 1000 range, down 12s at rank 1, and roots longer once it has passed through something.

audit.why: Packet flagged 'Use Depth Charge' as a probable wrong name — FALSE POSITIVE. Depth Charge is Nautilus's real ultimate.
53.85% over 13 games. TRICKY / 7.5 overstated the difficulty for a lane the page itself calls yours to take over; moved to EVEN / 6.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 7.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Tangle-Barbs and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 6/10. The lane is decided by how well you dodge Tangle-Barbs and how early you close it out.

edits.before: Depth Charge homes through her clone disguise and Pop Blossom flicker, knocking her up for a guaranteed kill.
edits.after: Depth Charge homes and cannot be dodged, and any immobilize you land breaks Inherent Glamour outright.

edits.before: Neeko is a squishy AP mage with no dash and no escape — exactly what your kit eats. Level 1 is roughly even since you have no all-in without W or E and she can poke with Blooming Burst (Q), so just farm and respect her root range. The second your Q + W + E are online you own it: land Dredge Line, the pull procs your passive root, then W splash burn and E slow chunk her so hard her squishy frame can't trade back. Watch for her E root from brush — if it lands she can follow with poke, but it doesn't kill you and your shield eats it.
edits.after: Neeko is a squishy AP mage with no dash and no escape — exactly what your kit eats. Level 1 is roughly even since you have no all-in without W or E and she pokes with Blooming Burst (Q), so farm and respect her root range. The second your Q + W + E are online you own it: land Dredge Line, the pull procs your passive root, then Titan's Wrath burn and Riptide chunk her frame. Watch Tangle-Barbs from brush — 1000 range, and it roots longer once it has passed through a minion, so never line up behind your wave.

edits.before: Land Dredge Line (Q) onto the real Neeko and chain passive root into E slow for a guaranteed short trade
edits.after: Hook or root anything suspicious — immobilizing CC breaks Inherent Glamour, so the disguise cannot survive it

notes: Chart was six rows out of seven wrong against the page's own prose, including a level-6 row that said Neeko while the level-6 spike called it a guaranteed Nautilus kill; all twelve side edits plus ratings are one atomic group.
